verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated `writing-skills` meta-skill that teaches the agent to author and test new skills. It frames skill writing as TDD: write pressure-scenario tests, watch them fail, write the skill, watch tests pass, then refactor to close loopholes. That covers both writing and improving, and an eval harness judges skill compliance across real agent sessions. Packaging is only lightly implied, via the note about cross-runtime skill directories like `~/.agents/skills/`. missing for 10: explicit guidance on packaging/distributing new skills (e.g., bundling into a plugin or marketplace), independent or hands-on corroboration of the skill-authoring workflow.
